researchNotes: Range taken from the official Shopify collection feed https://sergelutens.com/collections/parfums/products.json (handles used for product URLs); sets, samples and refills skipped. Official pages give no top/heart/base pyramid; notes are only ingredients the product description names explicitly (flat), so some entries have none. Year and perfumer not stated on pages (null). Chergui, Ambre sultan etc.: family as labelled on page. Some extrait-type entries are labelled 'Parfum' on the page.

Scentgrail — Serge Lutens Ambre Sultan review
